description: Defines the OrderAccount entity class for persistence, including properties like start/end dates, associated order, billing day, and related products.

classes.name: OrderAccount
classes.description: Entity class representing an order account with dates, billing info, and related products.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order account.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Returns a defensive copy of the start date.

methods.name: setOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date with a defensive copy.

methods.name: getOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Returns a defensive copy of the end date.

methods.name: setOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date with a defensive copy.

methods.name: getOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Returns the billing day of the account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Sets the billing day of the account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of associated OrderAccountProduct entities.
